**1/7** 🚀 Introducing NeuraCode

An open-source tool that gives AI coding assistants a "second brain" to truly understand your codebase.

Let me show you what it can do 🧵

#AI #OpenSource

**2/7** 😫 The Problem

If you use AI coding assistants, you know the pain:
• AI doesn't understand your project
• You explain the same things repeatedly
• AI makes changes without knowing impact
• Context is lost between sessions

**3/7** 🧠 The Solution: Code Brain

NeuraCode builds a complete knowledge graph of your code:
• Functions, classes, modules
• Dependencies and relationships
• Call chains and data flow
• Hotspots and critical paths

**4/7** 🔮 Predictive Context

NeuraCode anticipates what you need:
• Predicts context for tasks
• Prepares relevant files before you ask
• Suggests related tests and docs
• Learns from your workflow

**5/7** 📚 Continuous Learning

Gets smarter with every interaction:
• Learns your coding style
• Remembers your preferences
• Cross-session memory
• Pattern recognition

**6/7** 🌐 Universal Support

Works with 10+ AI agents:
• Claude Code
• Cursor
• Codex
• Gemini CLI
• OpenCode
• GitHub Copilot
• And more!

**7/7** 🎁 Open Source

• 12,500+ lines of Rust + Python
• 40+ programming languages
• MIT license
• 100% local, privacy-first
